<result>## Payphone model — complete

**Claim/session:** model `primitive:cube:10` (lane-payphone), claimed via the baked wrapper credentials the whole session; dismissed at the end.

**Body:** scaled the bootstrap cube to 0.35 w × 0.65 h × 0.25 d meters (x[-0.175,0.175], y[0,0.65], z[-0.125,0.125]), grounded at y=0, via three axis scales about pivot [0,0,0].

**Authored regions (final, from `look`):**
- `right`, `top`, `bottom`, `back` — untouched body faces (2 faces each)
- `facePanel.wall` (8 faces) — rim of the recessed front face panel (its `.cap` was consumed by the three sub-recesses cut into it)
- `coinSlot.cap`/`.wall` (2+8) — narrow recessed slot near panel top, y≈0.52–0.54, 6 mm deep
- `keypad.cap`/`.wall` (2+8) — mid-face recessed keypad well, y≈0.19–0.47, 8 mm deep
- `coinReturn.cap`/`.wall` (2+8) — low recessed coin-return cup, y≈0.11–0.14, 18 mm deep
- `handsetCradle.wall` (8) — skirt of the raised mounting boss on the left flank (its `.cap` consumed by the hook)
- `handsetCradleHook.cap`/`.wall` (2+8) — outward lip/hook nub at the end of the boss, where a handset would rest

**Totals:** 32 authored faces, 64 triangles, `unnamed: 0`, geometry `0 intersecting · 0 unreachable`.

**Bounding box:** x[-0.255, 0.175] (0.43 m including the handset-cradle protrusion off the left flank; body itself is 0.35 m wide), y[0, 0.65] m, z[-0.125, 0.125] m (0.25 m deep). Grounded at y=0 as required.

**Persistence:** `save` returned `ok:true` (save re-reads the written blob and rolls back on any semantic drop, so this is a real pass/fail signal, not just an echo).

**Refusals hit + adaptations (all expected background-lane behavior, not fought):**
- `shot`/offscreen capture — refused: "a background model has no framed scene" (the active editor tab was a different model, `primitive:cube:15`, belonging to another lane). Adapted by verifying everything numerically via `look`/`elements`/bbox math per the task's explicit instruction, never via screenshot.
- `semantic-status` — refused: belongs to the visible ModelView, background target can't run it. Did not switch the user's active tab to force it; relied on `save`'s own re-read/rollback guarantee as the persistence proof instead.

**Bug/finding worth flagging:** `basic-cut`'s `offset` parameter is measured from the **max end** of the selected face's local span, not the min end — e.g. `offset:0.874` on a y-span of [0.091,0.559] landed the cut at y≈0.15, not y≈0.50 as the "fraction along the span" wording suggests. Caught it via an `elements` read, undid, and recomputed with `offset = (max - target)/span` for every subsequent cut; all downstream cuts and insets landed exactly on target after that. Also hit the known inset-winding issue three times (each negative-distance recess produced 8 unreachable wall faces) and one positive-distance boss extrude that did *not* trigger it — fixed each occurrence with `select-audit(unreachable)` → `flip`, exactly per the brief's warning.</result>
